title: v1.0.2
subtitle: Sleep timer, resume position, EQ presets, track info, notices, missing files, settings backup, A-B loop, exclusive DAC, Android lock screen, Support, and an Arch Linux package.

items.title: Sleep timer
items.description: Stop playback after a set time, or at the end of the current track.

items.title: Restore position
items.description: Resume each track where you left off when you reopen the app.

items.title: EQ presets
items.description: Save and load EQ settings. Includes Flat, Rock, Classical, and Vocal, plus your own names.

items.title: Exclusive DAC
items.description: Exclusive mode can take over your DAC. If that fails, you see an error instead of silent fallback.

items.title: Android lock screen
items.description: Play, pause, and skip from the lock screen, notification, and headset on Android.

items.title: Support page
items.description: Settings links to support the project: Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee, Open Collective, thanks.dev, Trakteer, and Tako.

items.title: Arch Linux package
items.description: Install on Arch Linux with yay -S aqloss-bin.

items.title: ReplayGain from files
items.description: ReplayGain tags in your files are used after a library scan.

items.title: Crossfade length
items.description: Crossfade uses the full fade length you picked.

items.title: Faster library scan
items.description: Large folders finish scanning sooner.

items.title: Shared output default
items.description: New installs use Shared output, except on Windows, which still defaults to Exclusive. Your saved choice is kept.

items.title: Discord covers
items.description: Discord status uses public cover art only. Local files stay on this computer.

items.title: Track info
items.description: See tags, format, file path, ReplayGain, and play count for a track.

items.title: Scan and update notices
items.description: A notice when a folder has finished scanning, a scrobble has failed, or an update is available.

items.title: Missing files
items.description: Tracks whose files were moved or deleted leave the library. Playlists can remove those entries, and play skips them.

items.title: Settings backup
items.description: Export or restore settings, playlists, and music folders as a single file.

items.title: A-B loop
items.description: Repeat a section of the current track between two points you set.

items.title: Parametric EQ
items.description: More control per band than the 10-band graphic EQ, including width and shelf filters.

items.title: Crossfeed
items.description: A headphone filter that eases hard-panned recordings.

items.title: ReplayGain scanner
items.description: Scan your files and write ReplayGain tags, not only read them.

items.title: Waveform seeker
items.description: A waveform of the track as the seek bar, instead of a plain progress bar.

items.title: Playback speed
items.description: Play files faster or slower.

items.title: Tag editor
items.description: Edit title, artist, album, year, genre, and cover from the app.

items.title: Smart filter bar
items.description: Filter the library by genre, year, format, and bit depth without opening Settings.

items.title: Cover art fallback
items.description: If a file has no cover, look one up online.

items.title: Multi column sort
items.description: Sort by album, artist, and track number together, not only one field.

items.title: Loudness normalisation
items.description: Keep albums at a similar volume, as an alternative to ReplayGain.

items.title: MusicBrainz lookup
items.description: Fill in extra details such as genre, year, and label from MusicBrainz.

items.title: System tray
items.description: Minimize to the tray and control playback from a small panel without opening the full window.

items.title: Android folders
items.description: Pick music folders on Android and keep access after updates.
